Pinyin is filled in automatically when you finish editing. You can change any reading after |. Check names and words with multiple readings: context can change the pronunciation.

How do I type tones?

Type a number after each syllable: ma1 → mā · ma2 → má · ma3 → mǎ · ma4 → mà. Use 5 or no number for a neutral tone.

For 你好, type ni3 hao3. For 女, type nv3 or nu:3. Tone marks such as nǐ hǎo work too. Turn off “Check tones” to practice without tone numbers.
